about: Plays a clip in a frame that keeps its shape before the clip loads. A clip that starts by itself shows its poster to a reader who asks for reduced motion, shows the browser's controls, and plays muted.

background.about: A decorative loop with `controls={false}` and a button of its own that pauses it, because moving content that starts by itself needs a way to stop it. With reduced motion on, the loop does not start, and the button starts it.
background.title: Background with a pause button

fit.about: A 16:9 clip in a square. `cover` fills the square and crops the sides, and `contain` shows the whole frame between `bg.emphasized` bars.
fit.title: Fits

loop.about: `autoPlay` starts the loop muted, inline and with the browser's controls, so the reader can pause it. Turn on reduced motion in the system settings and reload: the loop shows its poster, and the controls start it.
loop.title: Playing by itself

loopCaption: The dashboard updates as each payment settles.

radius.about: The four corners of the theme, from the tightest to the fully round.
radius.title: Corners

ratio.about: The theme's seven ratios. The element keeps its shape before the clip's metadata loads, so nothing below it moves while the clip loads.
ratio.title: Ratios

title: Video

tour.about: The reader starts the clip from the browser's controls, which a keyboard and a screen reader already operate. The figure's caption names the clip.
tour.title: Started by the reader

tourCaption: A two-minute tour of the reconciliation screen.
